name: footval
description: Football match predictions for every game of Europe's top leagues — win, draw and loss chances, likeliest score, likely scorers and predicted line-ups — plus season projections with each club's title, top-four and relegation chances, independent player valuations with the reasons behind them, scouting, live scores, match centres, league tables, season statistics and transfer news.

interface.longDescription:
FootVal brings independent football player valuations, match predictions, statistics and live scores into ChatGPT.

Ask what a footballer is worth and get FootVal's estimated transfer value next to the market value, with the factors that explain the gap: performance, age and potential, contract, durability, reputation and form. Compare up to four players side by side, scout by league, club, nation, position, age, preferred foot and value, and list the most valuable, most undervalued and most overvalued players, the biggest risers and the best young talents.

Every morning, before the first kick-off, FootVal's match model also locks in its 10 most confident calls of the day: match result, double chance, total goals or both teams to score. Each comes with the model's probability, the likeliest score and scorer, and is marked right or wrong after the final whistle, with the model's hit rate over the last 7 and 30 days on the record.

FootVal also covers live football: scores and fixtures, match centres with events, team statistics and line-ups, league tables, a team's next and recent matches, season leaderboards for goals and assists, and the latest transfer news and rumours. Results appear as interactive cards you can tap through to a player, club, league or match.

Who it is for: football fans, fantasy managers, writers and anyone curious about what players are worth and how matches might go.

Good to know: FootVal's values and predictions are model estimates, not offers, betting advice or financial advice. Player valuations cover the European top divisions plus MLS and the Saudi Pro League; live data covers the competitions FootVal follows. FootVal is read-only: it never posts, buys or changes anything. Connecting requires signing in to FootVal.
capabilities: Estimate a player's transfer value and explain it
Find undervalued, overvalued and rising players
Scout players by league, position, age and value
Daily match predictions with the model's track record
Live scores, match centres and league tables
defaultPrompt: What is Lamine Yamal really worth, and why?
Who are the most undervalued players in the Premier League?
What are FootVal's match predictions for today?
